topics.title: UN week opens under pressure
topics.summary: World leaders opened the UN General Assembly amid anxiety over wars, AI competition, climate pressure, and the future role of the world body.
topics.discussionPrompt: If every leader walks into the UN with a different crisis folder, who tries to mediate and who asks where the coffee is?

topics.title: Burnham pitches UK AI role
topics.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham used meetings in New York to frame the UK as a serious AI player while acknowledging both benefits and risks.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a country says it wants to lead on AI, who imagines new breakthroughs and who immediately asks about guardrails?

topics.title: US-China talks eye AI and trade
topics.summary: Ahead of another Trump-Xi meeting, AP reports uneven progress on earlier agreements as both countries weigh trade, technology, investment, and AI competition.
topics.discussionPrompt: If two superpowers keep negotiating and competing at the same time, who calls that diplomacy and who calls it multitasking with consequences?

topics.title: Markets hover near records
topics.summary: Wall Street stayed close to record highs while Brent oil briefly dipped below $98, with investors watching earnings, energy prices, and global policy talks.
topics.discussionPrompt: When stocks are calm but oil keeps everyone watching, who says the market is confident and who says it is just pretending?

topics.title: Ukraine and Russia trade strikes
topics.summary: Ukraine and Russia exchanged new strikes as Zelenskyy prepared meetings at the UN, with Ukraine saying it hit more Russian oil refineries.
topics.discussionPrompt: When energy sites become part of the battlefield, who sees strategy shifting and who worries about how long ordinary people can absorb it?

topics.title: Middle East issues shadow UN
topics.summary: Middle East conflicts and diplomacy remained prominent around the UN gathering, including developments involving Yemen, Iraq, Iran, and wider regional tensions.
topics.discussionPrompt: If one summit has to hold this many tangled problems, who looks for tiny progress and who wants a giant whiteboard?

topics.title: Climate Week weighs AI demand
topics.summary: Climate Week talks highlighted renewable energy momentum while raising concerns that AI data centers could increase power and water demand.
topics.discussionPrompt: If AI can help solve climate problems but also uses a lot of energy, who sees tool and who sees headache?

topics.title: Planetary boundaries report alarms scientists
topics.summary: A new scientific update says key Earth health indicators have moved further outside safe ranges, intensifying debate about pollution, ecosystems, and climate stability.
topics.discussionPrompt: When scientists describe the planet like a dashboard full of warning lights, who wants big policy and who starts with their own habits?

topics.title: El Nino raises climate concern
topics.summary: The Guardian reports world leaders are facing renewed climate urgency as a powerful El Nino adds heat and disruption to already strained systems.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the weather pattern itself becomes a main character, who wants charts and who just wants to know what summer will feel like?

topics.title: Deep-sea film spotlights seabed life
topics.summary: A new Guardian-featured documentary explores strange Pacific seabed life, arriving as debate continues over possible industrial mining in deep ocean habitats.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a film makes the deep sea look alive and weird, who wants exploration and who says maybe leave the seafloor alone?
